Subject: Initial redlines and questions on DPA / SCCs routing

Diego —

Thanks for the draft MSA and Order Form. Our legal team has pushed back on a few DPA items and SCCs routing language. High level asks:

- Can Redwood accept the controller/processor split as currently redlined in the attached DPA? We flagged the KMS locality paragraph as a blocker for procurement (they want explicit onshore KMS for certain PHI-derived telemetry).
- We need a clear fallback routing policy in the SCCs if EU->US transfers are necessary (we suggested an onshore-only carveout for a subset of telemetry).
- Please confirm whether Redwood can provide a signed Annex for subprocessor list and monthly evidence of subprocessor changes.

We're hoping to close terms by end of next week; procurement wants any exceptions routed through their security review (Tom is cc'd).

Samira —

Appreciate the detailed pass. Quick responses and next steps below.

1) KMS locality: we can commit to a compartmentalized KMS option for the PHI-derived telemetry you called out. That would be an add-on in Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted we can offer an SLA-backed routing commitment plus a contractual obligation to use EU key residency for the listed telemetry types. I'll have Ben scope the ops impact.

2) SCCs fallback: agree we should add a short fallback policy that references the SCCs + onshore carveout for emergency operational need. Laura, can you draft a 2-paragraph fallback that references the Annex language Samira provided?

3) Subprocessor evidence cadence: we can provide a monthly exported list and 14-day notice for material changes. We'll propose that in the DPA.

Attached: HN-DPA-redline-v3.docx (our consolidated redline that accepts most of your edits, preserves our standard routing language with the optional KMS onshore addendum). Also included a clean OrderForm-Redline.pdf showing pricing impact for the KMS option.

Proposed actions:
- Laura to supply SCCs fallback language by EOD Fri (17 Apr).
- Ben to confirm ops feasibility and cost delta for KMS add-on by Mon (20 Apr).
- I'll prepare an exec summary for your procurement that highlights open items.

If that timeline works I'll update the DocuSign stub once we have Laura's fallback text.

Best,

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redline, SCCs routing option & KMS locality proposal

Diego / Samira —

Thanks — I reviewed the consolidated redline and inserted a short SCCs fallback paragraph that ties back to the Annex you suggested. Key points I changed/added: 

- Fallback scope limited to "operational continuity incidents" and defined examples (disaster recovery, urgent security patching requiring cross-border caching).
- Added a requirement that Redwood will provide a transfer impact assessment within 5 business days when invoking the fallback.
- Tightened the KMS addendum so that the onshore KMS obligation only applies to the PHI-derived telemetry class defined in Appendix A; for all other processing we'll keep default EU key residency where applicable.
- Added a once-per-quarter evidence bundle for subprocessor changes (monthly list retained as an ops artifact but contractual cadence reduced to quarterly to reduce noise).

Questions / open items for HealthNova:
- Is the 5-business-day TIA acceptable?
- Does procurement need to see draft pricing for dedicated KMS prior to sign (Ben to confirm ops cost).

I pasted the fallback paragraph at the end of the SCCs Annex and saved as HN-DPA-redline-v3.docx (tracked). If Samira is happy, I'll incorporate the small edits into the bound DPA and reissue.

—Laura
